d: How did the international media cover the INDIA bloc rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan? The New York Times, The Japan Times, The Guardian, Al Jazeera and Pakistan’s Dawn viewed the rally from different perspectives. While some highlighted the growing political challenge to the Modi government, others focused on questions surrounding the Election Commission’s credibility, voter list revisions and opposition unity. How did these publications assess the scale of the protest, the coming together of different movements and the opposition’s political strategy? Watch this report for a look at how…
